data.name: Mizanur
data.gender_notes: Mizanur is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘mizan’, meaning ‘balance’ or ‘scales’. In Islamic context, Mizanur refers to Allah's fair judgment and balance in the world. The name is often given to boys to signify righteousness, wisdom, and fairness. The name Mizanur carries the meaning “Balance, Scales” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mizanur usually hope their child will grow to embody balance, scales and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes Allah's fair judgment and balance.
data.etymology: Mizanur belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Balance, Scales.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mizanur total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
